title: Prohibited conditions.
officialText:
This method shall not be employed where either the quantity of air or the velocity of the
airflow will adversely affect other portions of the smoke control system, unduly intensify the fire, disrupt plume dynamics or
interfere with exiting. In no case shall airflow toward the fire exceed 200 feet per minute (1.02 m/s). Where the formula in
Section 909.7.1 requires airflow to exceed this limit, the airflow method shall not be used.
